news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.08 (down from ₹7.26 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.88b (up 18% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹644.8m (down 15% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 22% (down from 31% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 14%. Revenue is forecast to grow 20% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India.
